musicxml.label: MusicXML Score
musicxml.notes: SGML/XML parser; renders score metadata card with instrumentation.

bio.label: Bioinformatics (FASTA/FASTQ/VCF)

gff.notes: GFF2/GFF3/GTF genome annotation files. Feature type breakdown, sequence/chromosome list, sequence-region directives.

postscript.notes: Parses DSC (Document Structuring Conventions) comments only. PostScript execution not supported.

acf.label: Steam App Manifest (ACF)
acf.notes: Parses Valve KeyValues format. Shows game name, App ID, install state, depot info.

fits.label: FITS Astronomy Image
fits.notes: Parses FITS ASCII header cards. Image data rendering not supported.

kml.label: KML Map
kml.notes: Parses KML placemarks, folders, geometry types. No map rendering — shows structured list.

abc.label: ABC Music Notation
abc.notes: Parses ABC tune headers (X/T/C/K/M/Q). No audio playback or score rendering.

hl7.label: HL7 v2 Health Message
hl7.notes: Parses HL7 v2.x pipe-delimited segments. Shows segment table with type labels.

hydrogen.label: Hydrogen Drum Machine
hydrogen.notes: Parses Hydrogen XML song/drumkit files. Shows instruments, patterns, BPM.

prproj.label: Adobe Premiere Project
prproj.notes: Gzip-compressed XML project. Shows sequence/clip/media counts and frame rate.
knownParserGaps: Effect and transition details not shown

exe.label: Executable (ELF / PE / Mach-O)
exe.notes: Parses ELF (Linux), PE32/PE32+ (Windows EXE/DLL), and Mach-O (macOS) binary headers.
knownParserGaps: Only reads first 4 bytes of 64-bit entry point

chat.label: Chat Export (WhatsApp / Telegram / Discord)
chat.notes: Parses Telegram/Discord/Messenger JSON and WhatsApp text exports.
knownParserGaps: Facebook Export uses different schema variants

guitar-pro.label: Guitar Pro Tab
guitar-pro.notes: Parses GP3/4/5 binary headers for title/artist/album; GPX (ZIP+XML) reads score.gpif.

apk.label: Android Package (APK/AAB)
apk.notes: Shows DEX count, native ABIs, asset count, resource and signing status from ZIP structure.

iso.label: ISO 9660 Disc Image
iso.notes: Reads Primary Volume Descriptor at sector 16; shows volume ID, publisher, size, creation date.

dmp.label: Windows Minidump (.dmp)
dmp.notes: Pure-JS MDMP header parser; shows OS version, architecture, exception code, process ID

dxf.label: AutoCAD Drawing (.dxf)
dxf.notes: Pure-JS DXF group-code parser; shows sections, entity counts by type, layers, block names, header variables

mcworld.label: Minecraft World (.mcworld)
mcworld.notes: ZIP-based; uses JSZip to list files, parse levelname.txt and partial Bedrock level.dat NBT (LE). No Java Edition level.dat support.
knownParserGaps: Java Edition level.dat uses different NBT encoding (big-endian)

dicom.label: DICOM Medical Image (.dcm)
dicom.notes: Pure-JS Explicit VR LE DICOM tag parser; shows modality, study date, patient info (PHI warning), image dimensions. No pixel data rendering.
securityLimitations: PHI warning shown; no automatic redaction — user must handle compliance

netcdf.label: NetCDF Scientific Data (.nc)
netcdf.notes: Pure-JS NetCDF-3 (CDF\x01/\x02) header parser: dimensions, variables (with shape), global attributes. NetCDF-4/HDF5 shows info banner only.

kmz.label: KMZ Map Archive
knownParserGaps: Embedded overlays and network links not rendered

mbtiles.label: MBTiles Map Tileset
knownParserGaps: Tile data not decoded — metadata display only

pdb.label: Protein Structure (.pdb)
knownParserGaps: 3D visualization not yet implemented — text metadata only
Multi-model NMR ensembles show first model only

pcap.label: Network Capture (.pcap)
securityLimitations: Packet payload content not decoded or displayed
knownParserGaps: PCAPNG multi-interface captures show limited info
Payload protocols beyond Ethernet/IP/TCP/UDP/ICMP not parsed

xyz.label: Molecular Structure (.xyz)
knownParserGaps: 3D visualization not implemented — element table only

shapefile.label: ESRI Shapefile (.shp)
knownParserGaps: No map rendering — bounding box and record count only

wad.label: Doom WAD Game Archive
knownParserGaps: Lump data not decoded — lump listing only

sdf.label: SDF / MDL Molfile
knownParserGaps: No 3D structure visualisation (coords not rendered graphically)

cbor.label: CBOR Binary Data
knownParserGaps: BigInt (64-bit) values may lose precision above 2^53

arrow.label: Apache Arrow / Feather
knownParserGaps: Column types not decoded (FlatBuffers schema not fully parsed)
Feather v2 uses Arrow IPC format — same support level

cif.label: CIF Crystallographic Data
knownParserGaps: Large atom tables truncated in display

parquet.label: Apache Parquet
knownParserGaps: Thrift footer not fully decoded (no column types)

avro.label: Apache Avro
knownParserGaps: Data records not decoded (no Avro binary encoder)

msgpack.label: MessagePack

bson.label: BSON (Binary JSON)
knownParserGaps: Multi-document streams show only the first document

exr.label: OpenEXR Image

dbf.label: dBase / DBF Database
knownParserGaps: Memo field (.dbt/.fpt) content not loaded — only field names shown

Layer, block, and attribute data not decoded

step.label: STEP CAD Exchange (ISO 10303-21)

blend.label: Blender 3D Scene
knownParserGaps: Scene objects, meshes, and materials not parsed (requires Blender or bpy)

fbx.label: FBX 3D Animation
knownParserGaps: Mesh, skinning, and animation data not parsed (requires FBX SDK or three.js FBXLoader)

mat.label: MATLAB MAT-file
knownParserGaps: Only v5 format supported (v4 and v7.3/HDF5-based not parsed)

nifti.label: NIfTI
knownParserGaps: NIfTI-2 format (540-byte header) detected but not fully parsed
Voxel data not rendered (requires WebGL + niivue)

pyc.label: Python Bytecode
knownParserGaps: Bytecode disassembly not shown (requires Python dis module)
Source code not recoverable from this viewer

f3d.label: Fusion 360
knownParserGaps: Design history and timeline not parsed

deb.label: Debian Package
knownParserGaps: control.tar.gz decompression not implemented (shown as raw)

qif.label: QIF Financial
knownParserGaps: Investment transaction fields (Q, O, I, etc.) not parsed

mt940.label: MT940 Bank Statement
knownParserGaps: MT942 intraday statement format not differentiated

docker-compose.notes: docker-compose.yml/compose.yml service list, port mappings, volumes, depends_on graph.
